App was great until the ads. This app was nice and simple but four days ago the added very obnoxious video ads that blast sound whenever you do anything. If there was an option to pay a few bucks to avoid ads I’d be up for it but nope. I’m deleting this crap ware.
Great fasting app. I’ve tried a few others and most require to pay. This is free and is awesome! Good options and fits it’s purpose! I recommend this app!!
Nice. Easy to use. Helpful graphics. Encouraging without being overbearing. I like this app. Only been using for about a week so will check back in later.
Actively fasting. This app is totally awesome

Bar chart not working right. The bar graph seems to be showing only the planned fasting time, not the actual time of the fast. There is no way to go back to previous fast and determine exactly how long the fast lasted so that you can track it yourself. And although I have turned on all the reminders I do not get any reminders at all. Am going to McGiever a system myself at this point. Unwilling to pay for subscriptions for this type of functionality. I swear that App Store applications almost invariably ask you to subscribe or pay money. I suspect it's because Apple customers pay so much for their equipment they think we have money. I may check out applications on my android phone that I transition from to see if there's anything there that might be helpful.
Alarm Suggestion. An alarm within the app would be helpful to know when the fast begins and ends
1st Fast. My first Intermittent Fast is going very well. I am still learning if there are other features in this IF app.
First day. I think this is going to work great
Best free fasting app. I have tried many fasting apps and this is the best, totally free, totally simple! It tracks fasting time and that is all I needed!
FREE. A great simple intermittent fasting app that is truly FREE of cost! Finally!

A little unstable. It’s a decent tracker but unstable. Woke up this morning to see all 120+ hours of fasting gone after being requested to log in again. Needless to say, I was very, very frustrated and unhappy, deleting the app soon after several attempts to gain my info back unsuccessfully.
